newBookExtractScript.description:
JavaScript code to extract COMPLETE book metadata for auto-creation. Should return an object with:
- title: string
- description: string
- authors: array of strings
- tags: array of strings
- covers: array of {url, title?}
- chapters: array of {title, url, index, isFinal?}
newBookExtractScript.example:
(() => ({
  title: document.querySelector('h1').innerText,
  description: document.querySelector('.desc').innerText,
  authors: ["Author Name"],
  tags: ["Action", "Adventure"],
  covers: [{ url: "...", title: "Cover" }],
  chapters: [{ title: "Cap 1", url: "..." }]
}))()
